brief:
Israeli attacks in central and southern Gaza killed at least three people, including a woman and a child, Middle East Eye reported, citing medical sources at Wafa news agency. The strikes targeted areas across the two regions in what marked the latest in ongoing military operations.

No further details on the locations, timing, or circumstances of the attacks were immediately available.
dek: Israel kills three Palestinians, including a child, in attacks in central and southern Gaza Israeli attacks in central and southern Gaza have killed at least three people, including a woman and a child, Wafa reports, citing medical sources.
title: Israeli strikes kill three Palestinians including child in Gaza
